Monday announced a $225 million investment to modernize the GE Aerospace Research Center in Niskayuna, NY.

The State of New York has also committed $8.4 million in tax credits through Empire State Development (ESD) to the project, with Schenectady County Metroplex Development Authority contributing additional local incentives valued at $5.3 million.
GE Aerospace expects to begin site improvement projects immediately, and research operations at Niskayuna will continue with minimal disruption throughout construction.

title: GE Aerospace to invest $225M in upgrading New York research facility
